[SWS_FrTrcv_00229] Configuration "Notification for Wake-up by Bus"
Upstream requirements: SRS_Fr_05136
⌈The FlexRay Transceiver Driver shall support the compile time configuration of one
notification to a higher layer for change notification for "wake-up by bus" events.
One wake-up by bus event notification shall be supported to one higher layer.
If a transceiver device does not support "wake-up by bus", this notification is never
called for this bus.
Efficient coupling between FlexRay Transceiver Driver and higher layer.⌋
